content.text: {"sections":[{"section":"summary","body":"Harrowgate Precision Components remained in compliance with all financial covenants for the period ended September 30, 2026, and the compliance certificate agrees with the bank's calculations. The most notable change is lower leverage: total debt fell from {{fact:6ca0529d-74c6-452b-ae3b-6ce3d6a2fb27}} to {{fact:5caba09a-e41a-47af-92fa-0db3d6352fa9}} while EBITDA rose, bringing total debt to EBITDA down to {{fact:7a0d17d1-65c9-4fc9-b9cf-f392928d590e}} from {{fact:92722462-92d7-4e53-ae93-2bab47e41280}}. The borrowing base agrees with the bank's records. No early warning signals fired and no items await a decision."},{"section":"performance","body":"Trailing twelve month revenue rose to {{fact:aaf7db36-4005-45e0-916d-00414fbcae84}} from {{fact:d58b09a4-c81f-4ba2-a490-5fd1fde0fd03}}, growth of {{fact:4241ca32-6565-41f6-8095-1d7fd693d865}}. EBITDA increased to {{fact:ce34e953-2c95-4e5a-95b7-7df348d02552}} from {{fact:aa0fb33f-d5f3-4bbf-aff9-ba14fd4cb13d}}, with margin unchanged at {{fact:0a22d72a-963d-46f7-a6c7-8a4469e3beba}} against {{fact:4edde293-06d7-4b61-b877-2ae6b347822d}}. Net income rose to {{fact:fa49dd8e-e4e0-4cd5-a9dc-dd3ca6558ad5}} from {{fact:f1f334bb-c99a-446d-bd94-4eadd76d8ce5}}, and interest coverage improved to {{fact:bdd27747-313d-46cd-888b-a0a95ba4f50b}} from {{fact:b4e7214d-1c34-4157-8884-bab62442ade1}}. Working capital was broadly stable: the current ratio moved to {{fact:585e4524-8fcd-4514-874d-cca10a643eea}} from {{fact:c65ed8af-0b24-4f02-add9-1b40adb97059}}, days sales outstanding shortened to {{fact:d6fd8235-a371-4d34-a8b4-0a2d018a6202}} from {{fact:9d300592-95e2-498c-9248-859215220666}}, days payables eased to {{fact:dd1c6a40-d2a5-469a-b639-d1e13ebbe098}} from {{fact:5566fdaf-d23e-44c1-8210-3dbba39fbc07}}, and cash rose to {{fact:e2d8ee69-7c25-4d5b-8deb-6bacf0ab7d3c}} from {{fact:c5ac377b-8b41-42cd-a3fb-9be0b3c1b227}}."},{"section":"covenants","body":"All covenants were met, and in each case the certificate figure matches the bank's calculation. Tangible net worth was {{fact:5a9eb296-86bf-4474-af01-7edcf7d541c5}} against a minimum of {{fact:e93dc9a8-c2a6-4cd1-94dd-311f14be36fd}}, a cushion of {{fact:b3572085-0360-4731-827c-8e8d149ed3f5}}. The Total Leverage Ratio was {{fact:5623089b-fbb5-45bd-a4c5-08ddbb4ebc6d}} against a maximum of {{fact:e70b111b-b53e-4203-8e2b-c6b27fc2af9e}}, a cushion of {{fact:745e00d4-e54b-4e71-b74c-4bd1ed52a29e}}. The Total Leverage Ratio carries the smallest cushion of the three."},{"section":"collateral","body":"The borrowing base certificate for the revolving line of credit as of September 30, 2026 agrees with the bank's records, with no mismatched lines. A reviewer may wish to confirm that availability under the revolver, at {{fact:72616162-084b-4a70-be99-f8f546a6bc14}}, together with cash of {{fact:e2d8ee69-7c25-4d5b-8deb-6bacf0ab7d3c}}, is consistent with the borrower's liquidity needs, as the facts given do not address seasonal working capital requirements."}]}
